patterns: Many prompts bundled repeated calculations and extra extensions around a sound DOK-3 judgment.
Combined worksheets require attention to their internal lesson order: expected value, transformations, binomial ranking, and z-scores appeared before the relevant daily instruction.
Board figures and exact arithmetic need independent checks: dense dot stacks overlapped, small graphs shrank, discrete bars were displaced, and exact values were missing from graph-only calculations.
Short first takes, plain sentence frames, and three explicit reasoning elements make the work more accessible and quicker to hand-score.
